newsitem.title: NORWAY: FORECAST - Orkla 1996 profits seen up.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Orkla 1996 profits seen up.

text.p: Norwegian food-based company Orkla ASA is expected to post a 1996 pre-tax profit of 2.47 billion crowns, up from 1.93 billion in 1995, according to 10 analysts polled by Reuters.
Six analysts said buy, two said hold and one said sell the share. The remaining expert gave no recommendation.

The appreciating crown has in the past few months made some investors place their money in consumer shares such as Orkla, which has been regarded as a safe haven compared to more export-sensitive blue chips listed on the Oslo Bourse.

Analysts, thinking Orkla is undervalued in comparison with international competitors, have upgraded their revenue forecasts in 1997 and 1998 by about 15 and nine percent respectively compared to estimates made ahead of the eight-month results of 1996.
